==Purpose of template==
The purpose of this template is to let {{int:userprofile-global-tag-content-moderator}}s and {{int:userprofile-global-tag-sysop}}s know that a page needs to be deleted.

==How to use==
You just need to add <code><nowiki>{{delete|Your reason for deleting the page}}</nowiki></code> to the source editor of the article you believe needs deleted.

<code><nowiki>{{delete|Your reason for deleting the page}}</nowiki></code>

{{delete|Your reason for deleting the page}}
